steps.title: Before
steps.body: What were you doing before you found us?

steps.title: After
steps.body: What's different now that you use us?

steps.title: Proof
steps.body: What's one thing you can do now that you couldn't?

tiles.title: Yes or no questions
tiles.body: "Would you recommend us?" gets "Yes." Ask who, and why.

tiles.title: Leading questions
tiles.body: "How much has our amazing support helped?" sounds coached.

tiles.title: Double questions
tiles.body: Asking for praise and improvements at once splits the answer.

tiles.title: Jargon
tiles.body: Stiff questions get answers in the same stiff language.
